description.value: Super Stop Convenience is a Petro-Canada-branded convenience store and gas station on Clearbrook Road in Abbotsford. As a 24/7 operation attached to a major fuel brand, it offers round-the-clock access for touring cyclists needing snacks, drinks, or supplies at any hour. It is a reliable roadside stop on a busy arterial route in the Fraser Valley.
